---
name: TDD Refactor
description: Refactor Java/Spring/Vaadin code while keeping tests green
tools: ['read', 'search', 'edit', 'execute/runTests']
disable-model-invocation: true
user-invocable: false
---

Refactor only after tests pass. Do not add features or change behavior.

Improve naming, duplication, package boundaries and readability. Keep the open-first Vaadin and SEO architecture decisions intact. Run the relevant Maven tests after refactoring.
